description: 1nF 50V C0G ±5% 0805 Multilayer Ceramic Capacitors MLCC - SMD/SMT ROHS
compatibility_notes: Second code on the existing generic 0805 1 nF capacitor: the plain generic ID keeps its reviewed Basic preference C46653 (Samsung CL21B102KBCNNNC, X7R +/-10% 50 V). C1791 is the exact Samsung Electro-Mechanics C0G +/-5% SKU (CL21C102JBCNNNC, 50 V) from the same maker, so it gets its own maker/mpn variant ID linked via generic_oomp_id, following the established variant taxonomy. Rating comparison from the staged capture: same 1 nF value, package and 50 V rating, but C0G +/-5% is the more stable, tighter-tolerance dielectric than the X7R +/-10% preference; projects needing C0G stability at 1 nF/0805 should pick this variant explicitly and the X7R Basic preference is not downgraded. Two-terminal MLCC (pin_count 2); stock 113,668 recorded as observed.
